355	# After the change: runner exits 1 after failing to restore the artifact → PASSES.
356	assert_eq "[#1805/SPEC-2] resume exits 1 when primary artifact cannot be restored" \
357	    "1" "$_s2_rc"
358	
359	# [#1805/SPEC-2]: no stage.start event must be emitted before the exit.
360	# (exit 1 happens before the dispatch loop reaches any stage)
361	_s2_any_starts=0
362	if [[ -f "$S2_EVENTS_JSONL" ]]; then
363	    _s2_any_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start") | .type' \
364	        "$S2_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
365	fi
366	assert_eq "[#1805/SPEC-2] no stage.start emitted before exit 1" \
367	    "0" "$_s2_any_starts"
368	
369	# ── SPEC-5: ADR-006 amended with artifact-restore step 3.5 ───────────────────
370	print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-5] ADR-006 amended: step 3.5 restores artifacts before dispatch loop"
371	
372	# [#1805/SPEC-5]: ADR-006 must contain the amendment text describing artifact
373	# restoration in the resume sequence and exit 1 for an absent artifact.
374	# This passes after the doc change; it need not fail before.
375	_adr006="$(cat "$ADR_006" 2>/dev/null || true)"
376	
377	assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-5] ADR-006 step 3.6 added (step number present)" \
378	    "$_adr006" "3.6"
379	
380	assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-5] ADR-006 step 3.6 names _runner_resume_rehydrate" \
381	    "$_adr006" "_runner_resume_rehydrate"
382	
383	assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-5] ADR-006 step 3.6 names resume-rehydrate-test.sh as enforcing test" \
384	    "$_adr006" "resume-rehydrate-test.sh"
385	
386	assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-5] ADR-006 step 3.6 names resume-entry-points-test.sh as enforcing test" \
387	    "$_adr006" "resume-entry-points-test.sh"
388	
389	# [#1805/SPEC-5]: ADR-006 must document that a still-absent artifact causes exit 1.
390	# Before the doc change: the clause is absent → FAILS. After change: PASSES.
391	assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-5] ADR-006 step 3.6 documents still-absent artifact causes exit 1" \
392	    "$_adr006" "exit 1"
393	
394	# ── SPEC-6: ADR-050 §6 amended with resume boundary note ─────────────────────
395	print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-6] ADR-050 §6 amended with boundary note distinguishing resume from new runs"
396	
397	# Extract §6 from ADR-050: content from the "### 6." heading up to (not including) "### 7."
398	_adr050_s6="$(awk \
399	    '/^### 6\./{p=1} p && /^### [0-9]+\./ && !/^### 6\./{exit} p{print}' \
400	    "$ADR_050" 2>/dev/null || true)"
401	
402	# [#1805/SPEC-6]: §6 boundary note must say the invariant applies to new runs
403	# and that a resume is governed by ADR-006.
404	assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-6] ADR-050 §6 boundary note says invariant applies to new runs" \
405	    "$_adr050_s6" "new run"
406	
407	assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-6] ADR-050 §6 boundary note names ADR-006 as governing resume" \
408	    "$_adr050_s6" "ADR-006"
409	
410	# [#1805/SPEC-6]: §6 must say "a resume continues the same run" (not just reference ADR-006).
411	# Before the doc change: clause absent → FAILS. After change: PASSES.
412	assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-6] ADR-050 §6 boundary note says a resume continues the same run" \
413	    "$_adr050_s6" "continues the same run"
414	
415	# ── SPEC-12: fresh (non-resume) run dispatches all stages ─────────────────────
416	print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-12] fresh non-resume run dispatches all stages (ADR-050 §6 new-run side)"
417	
418	S12_STATE_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s12-state"
419	S12_EVENTS_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s12-events"
420	S12_EVENTS_JSONL="$S12_EVENTS_DIR/events.jsonl"
421	S12_STATE_FILE="$S12_STATE_DIR/pipeline-state.json"
422	mkdir -p "$S12_STATE_DIR/artifacts" "$S12_EVENTS_DIR"
423	
424	_S12_ID="$(zb_test_issue)"
425	S12_WORK_REPO="$(setup_git_temp_repo resume-fresh-work)"
426	# Use a cycle fixture so SPEC-12 and SPEC-13 use the same cyclic pipeline.
427	# artifact-snapshot-coverage has intake (leaf) + cyc (cycle); that satisfies SPEC-13.
428	install_template_overlay "$S12_WORK_REPO" artifact-snapshot-coverage
429	# cycled sub-stage of the cyc cycle declares roles:[builder]
430	mock_plugin_factory "cycled" "agent" 0 "" "builder" >/dev/null
431	
432	# Fresh state: no completed stages. status=in_progress and no --resume flag →
433	# runner treats this as a new run; no stage should be skipped.
434	jq -n \
435	    --arg run_id "s12-fresh-1805" \
436	    --arg now "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
437	    --argjson issue "$_S12_ID" \
438	    '{
439	        schema_version: 1,
440	        run_id: $run_id,
441	        issue: $issue,
442	        stage_statuses: {},
443	        current_iteration: 0,
444	        self_heal_count: {},
445	        scope_manifest_hash: "",
446	        cost_ledger_pointer: 0,
447	        claim_lease_id: "",
448	        plugin_state: {},
449	        status: "in_progress",
450	        updated_at: $now
451	    }' > "$S12_STATE_FILE"
452	
453	# Run WITHOUT --resume: a fresh (non-resume) run.
454	# Contrast with SPEC-1 where a resumed run skips complete stages.
455	set +e
456	( cd "$S12_WORK_REPO" && env \
457	    ZBUILD_PLUGINS_ROOT="$PLUGINS_ROOT" \
458	    ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S12_STATE_DIR" \
459	    ZBUILD_STATE_FILE="$S12_STATE_FILE" \
460	    ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR="$S12_EVENTS_DIR" \
461	    ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL="$S12_EVENTS_JSONL" \
462	    ZBUILD_EVENT_SCHEMA="$REPO_ROOT/config/event-schema.json" \
463	    ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn \
464	    ZBUILD_VISION_GATE=off \
465	    PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" \
466	    bash "$RUNNER" --template artifact-snapshot-coverage --issue "$_S12_ID" ) \
467	    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s12-stdout.txt" 2>"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s12-stderr.txt"
468	set -e
469	
470	# [#1805/SPEC-12]: intake must emit stage.start on a fresh run (not skipped by
471	# rehydration, which only applies on resume). This pins the new-run side of the
472	# ADR-050 §6 boundary: the prior-work reuse invariant governs new runs; a resume
473	# (governed by ADR-006) is the only path that may skip complete stages.
474	_s12_intake_starts=0
475	if [[ -f "$S12_EVENTS_JSONL" ]]; then
476	    _s12_intake_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start") | .data.stage // empty' \
477	        "$S12_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^intake$' 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
478	fi
479	assert_eq "[#1805/SPEC-12] fresh run dispatches intake (not skipped; ADR-050 §6 new-run side)" \
480	    "1" "$_s12_intake_starts"
481	
482	# [#1805/SPEC-12]: the cycled sub-stage must dispatch (cycle executed; no stage skipped).
483	# Before fix: ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=0 suppresses the cycle → cycled_starts=0 → assert_gt fails.
484	# After fix: cycles enabled, cycled sub-stage runs for the 1 configured iteration → PASSES.
485	_s12_cycled_starts=0
486	if [[ -f "$S12_EVENTS_JSONL" ]]; then
487	    _s12_cycled_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start") | .data.stage // empty' \
488	        "$S12_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^cycled$' 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
489	fi
490	assert_gt "[#1805/SPEC-12] fresh run dispatches cycled sub-stage (cycle ran; no stage skipped)" \
491	    "$_s12_cycled_starts" "0"
492	
493	# [#1805/SPEC-12]: the cycle fixture used for this fresh-run sub-case contains type: cycle,
494	# establishing that the fixture IS a cyclic pipeline (satisfying the "same cycle fixture" clause).
495	_s12_fixt_content="$(cat "$REPO_ROOT/tests/fixtures/templates/artifact-snapshot-coverage.yaml")"
496	assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-12] cycle fixture used in SPEC-12 fresh-run sub-case has type: cycle" \
497	    "$_s12_fixt_content" "type: cycle"
498	
499	# ── SPEC-13: test uses a fixture containing a cyclic stage ────────────────────
500	print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-13] resume-rehydrate test uses a fixture containing a cyclic stage"
501	
502	# [#1805/SPEC-13]: the fixture must contain type: cycle (satisfies "containing a cyclic stage").
503	# Already read into _s12_fixt_content above from artifact-snapshot-coverage.yaml.
504	assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-13] resume-rehydrate fixture contains type: cycle" \
505	    "$_s12_fixt_content" "type: cycle"
506	
507	# [#1805/SPEC-13]: a pipeline using that cyclic fixture was actually run in this test.
508	# _s12_cycled_starts was computed in the SPEC-12 section from the S12 pipeline run.
509	# Before fix: ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=0 → cycled never dispatches → 0 → assert_gt fails.
510	# After fix (cycles enabled, max_iter=1): cycled dispatches → assert_gt passes.
511	assert_gt "[#1805/SPEC-13] resume-rehydrate: pipeline with cyclic fixture was actually run (cycled dispatched)" \
512	    "$_s12_cycled_starts" "0"
513	
514	cleanup_test_env
515	print_test_results
516	exit $((FAIL > 0))

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Tests: resume rehydrates completed-stage artifacts from the git state branch
# before the dispatch loop. (issue #1805, ADR-006 §3.5)
#
# SPEC-1 [code]: on resume, runner calls _artifact_persist_restore +
#   _artifact_persist_put_back and places completed-stage artifacts into
#   ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR before the dispatch loop; the complete stage emits
#   no stage.start event.
#
# SPEC-2 [code]: a complete stage whose primary artifact is absent from both
#   disk and the git state branch causes the resume to exit 1 before any
#   stage.start event is emitted.
#
# SPEC-5 [no-code]: ADR-006-resume-contract.md amended with step 3.5:
#   before the dispatch loop the runner restores completed-stage artifacts from
#   the git state branch; a still-absent artifact causes exit 1; enforcing
#   test names added inline.
#
# SPEC-6 [no-code]: ADR-050-prior-work-reuse-contract.md §6 amended with
#   boundary note: the invariant applies to new runs; a resume continues the
#   same run and is governed by ADR-006.
set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
RUNNER="$REPO_ROOT/core/pipeline/runner.sh"
ZBUILD_CLI="$REPO_ROOT/scripts/zbuild"
ADR_006="$REPO_ROOT/docs/adr/ADR-006-resume-contract.md"
ADR_050="$REPO_ROOT/docs/adr/ADR-050-prior-work-reuse-contract.md"

# shellcheck source=../../scripts/lib/helpers.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/lib/helpers.sh"
# shellcheck source=../../scripts/lib/test-helpers.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/lib/test-helpers.sh"
# shellcheck source=../../core/state/artifact-persist.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/core/state/artifact-persist.sh"

print_test_header "resume-rehydrate — artifact restore on resume (#1805)"
setup_test_env "resume-rehydrate-1805"
export ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn

_ZB_ID="$(zb_test_issue)"

# ── Shared infrastructure ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Create a git repo that the runner will use (CWD of the subprocess).
# The state branch is written here; the runner also reads from here.
WORK_REPO="$(setup_git_temp_repo resume-rehydrate-work)"
git -C "$WORK_REPO" config user.email t@e.st
git -C "$WORK_REPO" config user.name t

install_template_overlay "$WORK_REPO" runner-state-dir-minimal

# Create mock plugins (intake + build, each declaring a primary artifact).
mock_plugin_factory "intake" "agent" 0 >/dev/null
mock_plugin_factory "build"  "agent" 0 >/dev/null
PLUGINS_ROOT="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/plugins"

# ── SPEC-1: resume rehydrates artifacts from git state branch ─────────────────
print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-1] resume restores completed-stage artifact into ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR"

S1_STATE_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1-state"
S1_EVENTS_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1-events"
S1_EVENTS_JSONL="$S1_EVENTS_DIR/events.jsonl"
S1_STATE_FILE="$S1_STATE_DIR/pipeline-state.json"
mkdir -p "$S1_STATE_DIR/artifacts" "$S1_EVENTS_DIR"

# Write the intake primary artifact so the snapshot captures it.
printf '{"result_contract":3,"outcome":"pass","reason":"prior-run intake"}' \
    > "$S1_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

# Snapshot the artifact onto the state branch in WORK_REPO.
_s1_snap_rc=0
( export ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S1_STATE_DIR"
  cd "$WORK_REPO" && _artifact_persist_snapshot "$S1_STATE_DIR" "$_ZB_ID" ) \
    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1-snap.log" 2>&1 || _s1_snap_rc=$?
if [[ "$_s1_snap_rc" -ne 0 ]]; then
    assert_fail "[#1805/SPEC-1] setup: snapshot to state branch failed" \
        "rc=$_s1_snap_rc; $(cat "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1-snap.log" 2>/dev/null | tail -5)"
else
    assert_pass "[#1805/SPEC-1] setup: state branch populated with intake-result.json"
fi

# Remove the artifact from disk to simulate the "artifacts not on disk" scenario.
rm -f "$S1_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

# Write state file: intake=complete, build=pending.
jq -n \
    --arg run_id "s1-resume-1805" \
    --arg now "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
    --argjson issue "$_ZB_ID" \
    '{
        schema_version: 1,
        run_id: $run_id,
        issue: $issue,
        stage_statuses: {intake: "complete", build: "pending"},
        current_iteration: 0,
        self_heal_count: {},
        scope_manifest_hash: "",
        cost_ledger_pointer: 0,
        claim_lease_id: "",
        plugin_state: {},
        status: "in_progress",
        updated_at: $now
    }' > "$S1_STATE_FILE"

# Run runner --resume. CWD=WORK_REPO so _artifact_persist_restore finds the
# state branch. Capture rc; do not abort on failure.
set +e
( cd "$WORK_REPO" && env \
    ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=0 \
    ZBUILD_PLUGINS_ROOT="$PLUGINS_ROOT" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S1_STATE_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_FILE="$S1_STATE_FILE" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR="$S1_EVENTS_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL="$S1_EVENTS_JSONL" \
    ZBUILD_EVENT_SCHEMA="$REPO_ROOT/config/event-schema.json" \
    ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn \
    ZBUILD_VISION_GATE=off \
    PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" \
    bash "$RUNNER" --template runner-state-dir-minimal --resume --issue "$_ZB_ID" ) \
    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1-stdout.txt" 2>"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1-stderr.txt"
_s1_rc=$?
set -e

# [#1805/SPEC-1]: artifact must be present in ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR after resume.
# Before the change: no rehydration → file absent → FAILS.
# After the change: rehydration copies artifact from state branch → PASSES.
assert_file_exists "[#1805/SPEC-1] intake-result.json rehydrated into ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR" \
    "$S1_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

# [#1805/SPEC-1]: intake must NOT have a stage.start event (it was complete and skipped).
_s1_intake_starts=0
if [[ -f "$S1_EVENTS_JSONL" ]]; then
    _s1_intake_starts="$(grep -c '"type":"stage.start"' "$S1_EVENTS_JSONL" \
        | xargs | grep -c '^[1-9]' 2>/dev/null || true)"
    # More precise: count stage.start events whose data.stage == "intake"
    _s1_intake_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start") | .data.stage // empty' \
        "$S1_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^intake$' 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
fi
assert_eq "[#1805/SPEC-1] intake emits no stage.start (complete stage skipped)" \
    "0" "$_s1_intake_starts"

# ── SPEC-1 path 2: auto-resume on status=interrupted ─────────────────────────
# [#1805/SPEC-1] all entry paths: path 2 — auto-resume when status=interrupted.
# No --resume flag; runner detects interrupted status and auto-resumes.
print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-1] path 2: auto-resume (status=interrupted) restores artifacts"

S1P2_ID="$(zb_test_issue)"
S1P2_STATE_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p2-state"
S1P2_EVENTS_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p2-events"
S1P2_EVENTS_JSONL="$S1P2_EVENTS_DIR/events.jsonl"
S1P2_STATE_FILE="$S1P2_STATE_DIR/pipeline-state.json"
mkdir -p "$S1P2_STATE_DIR/artifacts" "$S1P2_EVENTS_DIR"
touch "$S1P2_EVENTS_JSONL"

S1P2_WORK_REPO="$(setup_git_temp_repo resume-reh-s1p2)"
install_template_overlay "$S1P2_WORK_REPO" runner-state-dir-minimal

printf '{"result_contract":3,"outcome":"pass","reason":"prior-run intake"}' \
    > "$S1P2_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

_s1p2_snap_rc=0
( export ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S1P2_STATE_DIR"
  cd "$S1P2_WORK_REPO" && _artifact_persist_snapshot "$S1P2_STATE_DIR" "$S1P2_ID" ) \
    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p2-snap.log" 2>&1 || _s1p2_snap_rc=$?
if [[ "$_s1p2_snap_rc" -ne 0 ]]; then
    assert_fail "setup s1p2: snapshot failed (rc=$_s1p2_snap_rc)" \
        "$(cat "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p2-snap.log" 2>/dev/null | tail -5)"
fi
rm -f "$S1P2_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

jq -n \
    --arg run_id "s1p2-reh-1805" \
    --arg now "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
    --argjson issue "$S1P2_ID" \
    '{
        schema_version: 1, run_id: $run_id, issue: $issue,
        stage_statuses: {intake: "complete", build: "pending"},
        current_iteration: 0, self_heal_count: {}, scope_manifest_hash: "",
        cost_ledger_pointer: 0, claim_lease_id: "", plugin_state: {},
        status: "interrupted", updated_at: $now
    }' > "$S1P2_STATE_FILE"

set +e
( cd "$S1P2_WORK_REPO" && env \
    ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=0 \
    ZBUILD_PLUGINS_ROOT="$PLUGINS_ROOT" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S1P2_STATE_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_FILE="$S1P2_STATE_FILE" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR="$S1P2_EVENTS_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL="$S1P2_EVENTS_JSONL" \
    ZBUILD_EVENT_SCHEMA="$REPO_ROOT/config/event-schema.json" \
    ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn \
    ZBUILD_VISION_GATE=off \
    PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" \
    bash "$RUNNER" --template runner-state-dir-minimal --issue "$S1P2_ID" ) \
    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p2-stdout.txt" 2>"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p2-stderr.txt"
set -e

# [#1805/SPEC-1] path 2 artifact restored.
# Before change: no rehydration → absent → FAILS. After change: PASSES.
assert_file_exists \
    "[#1805/SPEC-1] path 2 (auto-resume/interrupted): intake-result.json restored" \
    "$S1P2_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

# [#1805/SPEC-1] path 2: build must have dispatched (proving pipeline ran and events written).
# Before fix: path-2 auto-resume doesn't exist → runner exits without events → build_starts=0 → FAILS.
# After fix: runner auto-resumes, rehydrates, skips intake, dispatches build → build_starts=1 → PASSES.
_s1p2_build_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start") | .data.stage // empty' \
    "$S1P2_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^build$' || echo 0)"
assert_eq "[#1805/SPEC-1] path 2 (auto-resume): build dispatched (pipeline ran via path-2 resume)" \
    "1" "$_s1p2_build_starts"

# [#1805/SPEC-1] path 2: intake must NOT have a stage.start event.
_s1p2_intake_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start") | .data.stage // empty' \
    "$S1P2_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^intake$' || echo 0)"
assert_eq "[#1805/SPEC-1] path 2 (auto-resume): intake emits no stage.start (skipped)" \
    "0" "$_s1p2_intake_starts"

# ── SPEC-1 path 3: zbuild pipeline resume --run-id ───────────────────────────
# [#1805/SPEC-1] all entry paths: path 3 — zbuild pipeline resume --run-id.
print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-1] path 3: zbuild pipeline resume --run-id restores artifacts"

S1P3_ID="$(zb_test_issue)"
S1P3_RUN_ID="s1p3-reh-1805"
S1P3_STATE_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p3-state"
S1P3_EVENTS_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p3-events"
S1P3_EVENTS_JSONL="$S1P3_EVENTS_DIR/events.jsonl"
S1P3_STATE_FILE="$S1P3_STATE_DIR/pipeline-state.json"
mkdir -p "$S1P3_STATE_DIR/artifacts" "$S1P3_EVENTS_DIR"
touch "$S1P3_EVENTS_JSONL"

S1P3_WORK_REPO="$(setup_git_temp_repo resume-reh-s1p3)"
install_template_overlay "$S1P3_WORK_REPO" runner-state-dir-minimal

printf '{"result_contract":3,"outcome":"pass","reason":"prior-run intake"}' \
    > "$S1P3_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

_s1p3_snap_rc=0
( export ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S1P3_STATE_DIR"
  cd "$S1P3_WORK_REPO" && _artifact_persist_snapshot "$S1P3_STATE_DIR" "$S1P3_ID" ) \
    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p3-snap.log" 2>&1 || _s1p3_snap_rc=$?
if [[ "$_s1p3_snap_rc" -ne 0 ]]; then
    assert_fail "setup s1p3: snapshot failed (rc=$_s1p3_snap_rc)" \
        "$(cat "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s1p3-snap.log" 2>/dev/null | tail -5)"
fi
rm -f "$S1P3_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

jq -n \
    --arg run_id "$S1P3_RUN_ID" \
    --arg now "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
    --argjson issue "$S1P3_ID" \
    '{
        schema_version: 1, run_id: $run_id, issue: $issue,
        stage_statuses: {intake: "complete", build: "pending"},
        current_iteration: 0, self_heal_count: {}, scope_manifest_hash: "",
        cost_ledger_pointer: 0, claim_lease_id: "", plugin_state: {},
        status: "interrupted", updated_at: $now
    }' > "$S1P3_STATE_FILE"

set +e
( cd "$S1P3_WORK_REPO" && env \
    ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=0 \
    ZBUILD_PLUGINS_ROOT="$PLUGINS_ROOT" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S1P3_STATE_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR="$S1P3_EVENTS_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL="$S1P3_EVENTS_JSONL" \
    ZBUILD_EVENT_SCHEMA="$REPO_ROOT/config/event-schema.json" \
    ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn \
    ZBUILD_VISION_GATE=off \
    PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" \
    bash "$ZBUILD_CLI" pipeline resume \
        --run-id "$S1P3_RUN_ID" \

    "$S1P3_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^build$' || echo 0)"

WORK_REPO2="$(setup_git_temp_repo resume-rehydrate-work2)"
git -C "$WORK_REPO2" config user.email t@e.st
git -C "$WORK_REPO2" config user.name t
install_template_overlay "$WORK_REPO2" runner-state-dir-minimal

jq -n \
    --arg run_id "s2-resume-1805" \
    --arg now "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
    --argjson issue "$_S2_ID" \

        self_heal_count: {},
        scope_manifest_hash: "",
        cost_ledger_pointer: 0,
        claim_lease_id: "",

set +e

    ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=0 \
    ZBUILD_PLUGINS_ROOT="$PLUGINS_ROOT" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S2_STATE_DIR" \

    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s2-stdout.txt" 2>"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s2-stderr.txt"
_s2_rc=$?
set -e

# [#1805/SPEC-2]: runner must exit 1 when artifact absent from disk AND state branch.
# Before the change: runner warns about stale artifact and continues → exits 0 → FAILS.
# After the change: runner exits 1 after failing to restore the artifact → PASSES.
assert_eq "[#1805/SPEC-2] resume exits 1 when primary artifact cannot be restored" \
    "1" "$_s2_rc"

# restoration in the resume sequence and exit 1 for an absent artifact.
# This passes after the doc change; it need not fail before.
_adr006="$(cat "$ADR_006" 2>/dev/null || true)"

assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-5] ADR-006 step 3.6 added (step number present)" \

assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-5] ADR-006 step 3.6 names _runner_resume_rehydrate" \
    "$_adr006" "_runner_resume_rehydrate"

assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-5] ADR-006 step 3.6 names resume-rehydrate-test.sh as enforcing test" \
    "$_adr006" "resume-rehydrate-test.sh"

assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-5] ADR-006 step 3.6 names resume-entry-points-test.sh as enforcing test" \
    "$_adr006" "resume-entry-points-test.sh"

# [#1805/SPEC-5]: ADR-006 must document that a still-absent artifact causes exit 1.
# Before the doc change: the clause is absent → FAILS. After change: PASSES.
assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-5] ADR-006 step 3.6 documents still-absent artifact causes exit 1" \
    "$_adr006" "exit 1"

# ── SPEC-6: ADR-050 §6 amended with resume boundary note ─────────────────────
print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-6] ADR-050 §6 amended with boundary note distinguishing resume from new runs"

# Extract §6 from ADR-050: content from the "### 6." heading up to (not including) "### 7."
_adr050_s6="$(awk \
    '/^### 6\./{p=1} p && /^### [0-9]+\./ && !/^### 6\./{exit} p{print}' \
    "$ADR_050" 2>/dev/null || true)"

# [#1805/SPEC-6]: §6 boundary note must say the invariant applies to new runs
# and that a resume is governed by ADR-006.
assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-6] ADR-050 §6 boundary note says invariant applies to new runs" \
    "$_adr050_s6" "new run"

assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-6] ADR-050 §6 boundary note names ADR-006 as governing resume" \
    "$_adr050_s6" "ADR-006"

# [#1805/SPEC-6]: §6 must say "a resume continues the same run" (not just reference ADR-006).
# Before the doc change: clause absent → FAILS. After change: PASSES.
assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-6] ADR-050 §6 boundary note says a resume continues the same run" \
    "$_adr050_s6" "continues the same run"

# ── SPEC-12: fresh (non-resume) run dispatches all stages ─────────────────────
print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-12] fresh non-resume run dispatches all stages (ADR-050 §6 new-run side)"

S12_STATE_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s12-state"
S12_EVENTS_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s12-events"
S12_EVENTS_JSONL="$S12_EVENTS_DIR/events.jsonl"

mkdir -p "$S12_STATE_DIR/artifacts" "$S12_EVENTS_DIR"

_S12_ID="$(zb_test_issue)"
S12_WORK_REPO="$(setup_git_temp_repo resume-fresh-work)"
# Use a cycle fixture so SPEC-12 and SPEC-13 use the same cyclic pipeline.
# artifact-snapshot-coverage has intake (leaf) + cyc (cycle); that satisfies SPEC-13.
install_template_overlay "$S12_WORK_REPO" artifact-snapshot-coverage
# cycled sub-stage of the cyc cycle declares roles:[builder]
mock_plugin_factory "cycled" "agent" 0 "" "builder" >/dev/null

# Fresh state: no completed stages. status=in_progress and no --resume flag →
# runner treats this as a new run; no stage should be skipped.

    ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S12_STATE_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_FILE="$S12_STATE_FILE" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR="$S12_EVENTS_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL="$S12_EVENTS_JSONL" \

    ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn \

    bash "$RUNNER" --template artifact-snapshot-coverage --issue "$_S12_ID" ) \
    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s12-stdout.txt" 2>"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s12-stderr.txt"
set -e

# [#1805/SPEC-12]: intake must emit stage.start on a fresh run (not skipped by
# rehydration, which only applies on resume). This pins the new-run side of the
# ADR-050 §6 boundary: the prior-work reuse invariant governs new runs; a resume
# (governed by ADR-006) is the only path that may skip complete stages.
_s12_intake_starts=0
if [[ -f "$S12_EVENTS_JSONL" ]]; then
    _s12_intake_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start") | .data.stage // empty' \
        "$S12_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^intake$' 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
fi
assert_eq "[#1805/SPEC-12] fresh run dispatches intake (not skipped; ADR-050 §6 new-run side)" \
    "1" "$_s12_intake_starts"

# [#1805/SPEC-12]: the cycled sub-stage must dispatch (cycle executed; no stage skipped).
# Before fix: ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=0 suppresses the cycle → cycled_starts=0 → assert_gt fails.
# After fix: cycles enabled, cycled sub-stage runs for the 1 configured iteration → PASSES.
_s12_cycled_starts=0
if [[ -f "$S12_EVENTS_JSONL" ]]; then
    _s12_cycled_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start") | .data.stage // empty' \
        "$S12_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^cycled$' 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
fi
assert_gt "[#1805/SPEC-12] fresh run dispatches cycled sub-stage (cycle ran; no stage skipped)" \
    "$_s12_cycled_starts" "0"

# [#1805/SPEC-12]: the cycle fixture used for this fresh-run sub-case contains type: cycle,
# establishing that the fixture IS a cyclic pipeline (satisfying the "same cycle fixture" clause).
_s12_fixt_content="$(cat "$REPO_ROOT/tests/fixtures/templates/artifact-snapshot-coverage.yaml")"
assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-12] cycle fixture used in SPEC-12 fresh-run sub-case has type: cycle" \
    "$_s12_fixt_content" "type: cycle"

# ── SPEC-13: test uses a fixture containing a cyclic stage ────────────────────
print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-13] resume-rehydrate test uses a fixture containing a cyclic stage"

# [#1805/SPEC-13]: the fixture must contain type: cycle (satisfies "containing a cyclic stage").
# Already read into _s12_fixt_content above from artifact-snapshot-coverage.yaml.
assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-13] resume-rehydrate fixture contains type: cycle" \
    "$_s12_fixt_content" "type: cycle"

# [#1805/SPEC-13]: a pipeline using that cyclic fixture was actually run in this test.
# _s12_cycled_starts was computed in the SPEC-12 section from the S12 pipeline run.
# Before fix: ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=0 → cycled never dispatches → 0 → assert_gt fails.
# After fix (cycles enabled, max_iter=1): cycled dispatches → assert_gt passes.
assert_gt "[#1805/SPEC-13] resume-rehydrate: pipeline with cyclic fixture was actually run (cycled dispatched)" \
    "$_s12_cycled_starts" "0"

cleanup_test_env
print_test_results
exit $((FAIL > 0))

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Tests: --from-stage <s> rehydrates completed-stage artifacts before dispatching <s>.
# (issue #1805, ADR-006 §3.5 / _runner_from_stage_preflight)
#
# SPEC-3 [code]: --from-stage <s> rehydrates all stages before <s> via
#   _artifact_persist_restore and _artifact_persist_put_back, places their
#   artifacts in ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR, dispatches <s> as the first stage, and
#   emits no stage.start for any earlier stage.
#
# SPEC-4 [code]: --from-stage <s> when a stage before <s> has no restorable
#   artifact exits 1 before dispatching anything and names the missing stage
#   in stderr.
set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
RUNNER="$REPO_ROOT/core/pipeline/runner.sh"

# shellcheck source=../../scripts/lib/helpers.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/lib/helpers.sh"
# shellcheck source=../../scripts/lib/test-helpers.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/lib/test-helpers.sh"
# shellcheck source=../../core/state/artifact-persist.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/core/state/artifact-persist.sh"

print_test_header "from-stage-rehydrate — artifact restore on --from-stage (#1805)"
setup_test_env "from-stage-rehydrate-1805"
export ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn

# ── SPEC-3: --from-stage rehydrates stages before <s> from git state branch ──
print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-3] --from-stage rehydrates prior-stage artifacts and skips their stage.start"

S3_ID="$(zb_test_issue)"
S3_STATE_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s3-state"
S3_EVENTS_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s3-events"
S3_EVENTS_JSONL="$S3_EVENTS_DIR/events.jsonl"
S3_STATE_FILE="$S3_STATE_DIR/pipeline-state.json"
mkdir -p "$S3_STATE_DIR/artifacts" "$S3_EVENTS_DIR"

# Create a git repo; _artifact_persist_snapshot writes the state branch here.
S3_WORK_REPO="$(setup_git_temp_repo fs-rehydrate-s3)"
install_template_overlay "$S3_WORK_REPO" runner-state-dir-minimal

# Create mock plugins.
mock_plugin_factory "intake" "agent" 0 >/dev/null
mock_plugin_factory "build"  "agent" 0 >/dev/null
# cycled sub-stage used by the artifact-snapshot-coverage cyclic fixture (SPEC-13 sub-case).
mock_plugin_factory "cycled" "agent" 0 "" "builder" >/dev/null
S3_PLUGINS_ROOT="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/plugins"

# Create the intake primary artifact so the snapshot picks it up.
printf '{"result_contract":3,"outcome":"pass","reason":"prior-run intake"}' \
    > "$S3_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

# Snapshot onto the state branch in S3_WORK_REPO.
_s3_snap_rc=0
( export ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S3_STATE_DIR"
  cd "$S3_WORK_REPO" && _artifact_persist_snapshot "$S3_STATE_DIR" "$S3_ID" ) \
    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s3-snap.log" 2>&1 || _s3_snap_rc=$?
if [[ "$_s3_snap_rc" -ne 0 ]]; then
    assert_fail "[#1805/SPEC-3] setup: snapshot to state branch failed" \
        "rc=$_s3_snap_rc; $(cat "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s3-snap.log" 2>/dev/null | tail -5)"
else
    assert_pass "[#1805/SPEC-3] setup: state branch populated"
fi

# Remove the artifact from disk; it now lives only on the state branch.
rm -f "$S3_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

# Write state file: intake=complete, build=pending, status=in_progress.
jq -n \
    --arg run_id "s3-fs-1805" \
    --arg now "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
    --argjson issue "$S3_ID" \
    '{
        schema_version: 1,
        run_id: $run_id,
        issue: $issue,
        stage_statuses: {intake: "complete", build: "pending"},
        current_iteration: 0,
        self_heal_count: {},
        scope_manifest_hash: "",
        cost_ledger_pointer: 0,
        claim_lease_id: "",
        plugin_state: {},
        status: "in_progress",
        updated_at: $now
    }' > "$S3_STATE_FILE"

# Run runner with --from-stage build. CWD=S3_WORK_REPO so the state branch
# is reachable. Artifact must be restored before build dispatches.
set +e
( cd "$S3_WORK_REPO" && env \
    ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=0 \
    ZBUILD_PLUGINS_ROOT="$S3_PLUGINS_ROOT" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S3_STATE_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_FILE="$S3_STATE_FILE" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR="$S3_EVENTS_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL="$S3_EVENTS_JSONL" \
    ZBUILD_EVENT_SCHEMA="$REPO_ROOT/config/event-schema.json" \
    ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn \
    ZBUILD_VISION_GATE=off \
    PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" \
    bash "$RUNNER" --template runner-state-dir-minimal \
        --resume --from-stage build --issue "$S3_ID" ) \
    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s3-stdout.txt" 2>"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s3-stderr.txt"
_s3_rc=$?
set -e

# [#1805/SPEC-3]: intake artifact must be in ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR after --from-stage.
# Before the change: no rehydration → file absent → FAILS.
# After the change: _runner_from_stage_preflight restores it → PASSES.
assert_file_exists \
    "[#1805/SPEC-3] intake-result.json rehydrated into ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR via --from-stage" \
    "$S3_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

# [#1805/SPEC-3]: the restored artifact must carry the payload originally snapshotted to
# the git state branch — this proves _artifact_persist_restore read from git and
# _artifact_persist_put_back placed it in ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR (not re-created fresh by
# the runner through any other mechanism).
# Before the change: no restore → file absent → content="" → FAILS.
# After the change: git state restore → original content present → PASSES.
_s3_restored_content="$(cat "$S3_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json" 2>/dev/null || true)"
assert_contains \
    "[#1805/SPEC-3] restored artifact contains original payload (proves _artifact_persist_restore + _artifact_persist_put_back used git state branch)" \
    "$_s3_restored_content" "prior-run intake"

# [#1805/SPEC-3]: intake must emit no stage.start event (it was skipped).
# Before the change: no rehydration means intake might be re-dispatched → stage.start emitted → FAILS.
# After the change: intake is complete and skipped entirely → no stage.start → PASSES.
_s3_intake_starts=0
if [[ -f "$S3_EVENTS_JSONL" ]]; then
    _s3_intake_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start") | .data.stage // empty' \
        "$S3_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^intake$' 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
fi
assert_eq "[#1805/SPEC-3] intake emits no stage.start when skipped via --from-stage" \
    "0" "$_s3_intake_starts"

# [#1805/SPEC-3]: build must be the FIRST stage dispatched (stage.start with stage==build).
# Before the change: without rehydration the runner may re-dispatch intake first → FAILS.
# After the change: intake is skipped; build (the --from-stage target) is first → PASSES.
_s3_first_dispatched=""
if [[ -f "$S3_EVENTS_JSONL" ]]; then
    # Use jq -rs to slurp all objects and pick .[0] — avoids | head (SIGPIPE-prone).
    _s3_first_dispatched="$(jq -rs \
        'map(select(.type=="stage.start") | .data.stage // empty) | .[0] // ""' \
        "$S3_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null || true)"
fi
assert_eq "[#1805/SPEC-3] build is the first dispatched stage (--from-stage target, intake skipped)" \
    "build" "$_s3_first_dispatched"

# ── SPEC-4: missing artifact with --from-stage exits 1 and names missing stage ─
print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-4] --from-stage with no restorable artifact exits 1 naming missing stage"

S4_ID="$(zb_test_issue)"
S4_STATE_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s4-state"
S4_EVENTS_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s4-events"
S4_EVENTS_JSONL="$S4_EVENTS_DIR/events.jsonl"
S4_STATE_FILE="$S4_STATE_DIR/pipeline-state.json"
mkdir -p "$S4_STATE_DIR/artifacts" "$S4_EVENTS_DIR"

# Fresh repo with no state branch for S4_ID — no artifact anywhere.
S4_WORK_REPO="$(setup_git_temp_repo fs-rehydrate-s4)"
install_template_overlay "$S4_WORK_REPO" runner-state-dir-minimal

# State: intake=complete, build=pending, NO artifact on disk, NO state branch.
jq -n \
    --arg run_id "s4-fs-1805" \
    --arg now "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
    --argjson issue "$S4_ID" \
    '{
        schema_version: 1,
        run_id: $run_id,
        issue: $issue,
        stage_statuses: {intake: "complete", build: "pending"},
        current_iteration: 0,
        self_heal_count: {},
        scope_manifest_hash: "",
        cost_ledger_pointer: 0,
        claim_lease_id: "",
        plugin_state: {},
        status: "in_progress",
        updated_at: $now
    }' > "$S4_STATE_FILE"

set +e
( cd "$S4_WORK_REPO" && env \
    ZBUILD_CYCLES_ENABLED=0 \
    ZBUILD_PLUGINS_ROOT="$S3_PLUGINS_ROOT" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$S4_STATE_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_FILE="$S4_STATE_FILE" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR="$S4_EVENTS_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL="$S4_EVENTS_JSONL" \
    ZBUILD_EVENT_SCHEMA="$REPO_ROOT/config/event-schema.json" \
    ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn \
    ZBUILD_VISION_GATE=off \
    PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" \
    bash "$RUNNER" --template runner-state-dir-minimal \
        --resume --from-stage build --issue "$S4_ID" ) \
    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s4-stdout.txt" 2>"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s4-stderr.txt"
_s4_rc=$?
set -e

# [#1805/SPEC-4]: runner must exit 1 when prior stage has no restorable artifact.
# Before the change: runner has no preflight check → continues → exits 0 → FAILS.
# After the change: _runner_from_stage_preflight exits 1 → PASSES.
assert_eq "[#1805/SPEC-4] --from-stage exits 1 when prior stage has no restorable artifact" \
    "1" "$_s4_rc"

# [#1805/SPEC-4]: stderr must name the missing stage ("intake").
_s4_stderr="$(cat "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s4-stderr.txt" 2>/dev/null || true)"
assert_contains \
    "[#1805/SPEC-4] stderr names the missing stage (intake)" \
    "$_s4_stderr" "intake"

# [#1805/SPEC-4]: no stage.start must be emitted before the exit.
_s4_any_starts=0
if [[ -f "$S4_EVENTS_JSONL" ]]; then
    _s4_any_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start") | .type' \
        "$S4_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
fi
assert_eq "[#1805/SPEC-4] no stage.start emitted before exit 1" \
    "0" "$_s4_any_starts"

# ── SPEC-13: test uses a fixture containing a cyclic stage ────────────────────
print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-13] from-stage-rehydrate test uses a fixture containing a cyclic stage"

# Run a fresh pipeline against the cyclic fixture (artifact-snapshot-coverage) to
# demonstrate that this test file exercises a pipeline containing a cyclic stage.
_S13_FS_ID="$(zb_test_issue)"
_S13_FS_WORK="$(setup_git_temp_repo fs-s13-cycle-check)"
install_template_overlay "$_S13_FS_WORK" artifact-snapshot-coverage

_S13_FS_STATE_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s13fs-state"
_S13_FS_EVENTS_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s13fs-events"
_S13_FS_EVENTS_JSONL="$_S13_FS_EVENTS_DIR/events.jsonl"
_S13_FS_STATE_FILE="$_S13_FS_STATE_DIR/pipeline-state.json"
mkdir -p "$_S13_FS_STATE_DIR/artifacts" "$_S13_FS_EVENTS_DIR"

jq -n \
    --arg run_id "s13fs-fresh-1805" \
    --arg now "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
    --argjson issue "$_S13_FS_ID" \
    '{
        schema_version: 1, run_id: $run_id, issue: $issue,
        stage_statuses: {}, current_iteration: 0, self_heal_count: {},
        scope_manifest_hash: "", cost_ledger_pointer: 0, claim_lease_id: "",
        plugin_state: {}, status: "in_progress", updated_at: $now
    }' > "$_S13_FS_STATE_FILE"

set +e
( cd "$_S13_FS_WORK" && env \
    ZBUILD_PLUGINS_ROOT="$S3_PLUGINS_ROOT" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$_S13_FS_STATE_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_FILE="$_S13_FS_STATE_FILE" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR="$_S13_FS_EVENTS_DIR" \
    ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL="$_S13_FS_EVENTS_JSONL" \
    ZBUILD_EVENT_SCHEMA="$REPO_ROOT/config/event-schema.json" \
    ZBUILD_CONTRACT_VALIDATOR=warn \
    ZBUILD_VISION_GATE=off \
    PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" \
    bash "$RUNNER" --template artifact-snapshot-coverage --issue "$_S13_FS_ID" ) \
    >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s13fs-stdout.txt" 2>"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/s13fs-stderr.txt"
set -e

# [#1805/SPEC-13]: the fixture is cyclic (type: cycle present).
_s13_fs_content="$(cat "$REPO_ROOT/tests/fixtures/templates/artifact-snapshot-coverage.yaml")"
assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-13] from-stage-rehydrate test uses a cyclic fixture (type: cycle)" \
    "$_s13_fs_content" "type: cycle"

# [#1805/SPEC-13]: confirm the cyclic pipeline ran (intake dispatched in the fresh run).
_s13_fs_intake_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start") | .data.stage // empty' \
    "$_S13_FS_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^intake$' || echo 0)"
assert_eq "[#1805/SPEC-13] cyclic fixture pipeline ran in from-stage-rehydrate test (intake dispatched)" \
    "1" "$_s13_fs_intake_starts"

cleanup_test_env
print_test_results
exit $((FAIL > 0))

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# Tests: cycle orchestrator reads persisted current_iter and starts the
3	# iteration loop from that value (not 1) on resume. (issue #1805, ADR-006 §3.5)
4	#
5	# SPEC-7 [code]: Cycle orchestrator reads cycle_iterations[CYCLE_ID].current_iter
6	#   from persisted state at resume and starts the iteration loop from that value
7	#   (not 1); iter-1 complete stages emit no stage.start on resume into iter-2.
8	#   Its test must FAIL on the code as it was before this change.
9	set -euo pipefail
10	
11	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
12	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
13	FIXT="$REPO_ROOT/tests/fixtures/templates"
14	
15	# shellcheck source=../../scripts/lib/helpers.sh
16	source "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/lib/helpers.sh"
17	# shellcheck source=../../scripts/lib/test-helpers.sh
18	source "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/lib/test-helpers.sh"
19	
20	print_test_header "resume-loop-state — cycle orchestrator resumes from persisted iter (#1805)"
21	setup_test_env "resume-loop-state-1805"
22	
23	export ZBUILD_EVENT_SCHEMA="$REPO_ROOT/config/event-schema.json"
24	export ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/events"
25	export ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL="$ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR/events.jsonl"
26	export ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/state"
27	mkdir -p "$ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR" "$ZBUILD_STATE_DIR"
28	
29	# shellcheck source=../../core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh
30	source "$REPO_ROOT/core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh"
31	# shellcheck source=../../core/pipeline/template.sh
32	source "$REPO_ROOT/core/pipeline/template.sh"
33	# shellcheck source=../lib/cycle-report-stub.sh
34	source "$REPO_ROOT/tests/lib/cycle-report-stub.sh"
35	
36	STATE_FILE="$ZBUILD_STATE_DIR/pipeline-state.json"
37	
38	# ── SPEC-7: cycle starts from persisted current_iter on resume ─────────────────
39	print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-7] cycle orchestrator resumes from current_iter (not 1)"
40	
41	# Seed minimal state file required by _cycle_state_init.
42	: > "$ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL"
43	jq -n '{schema_version:1, stage_statuses:{}, updated_at:"seed"}' > "$STATE_FILE"
44	
45	# Use zb_engine_loop_state to write one completed iteration (current_iter=1)
46	# into the state file. This simulates: iter-1 of the cycle has run and
47	# completed; the run was then interrupted before iter-2 dispatched.
48	# After the change the orchestrator will read current_iter=1 and start from
49	# iter-2 (current_iter + 1). Before the change it starts from iter=1.
50	zb_engine_loop_state "$STATE_FILE" "build-test" 1 5 "in_progress"
51	
52	# Load the cycle template.
53	load_template "$FIXT/cycle-converges-iter2.yaml"
54	
55	# Mock cycle_dispatch_stage: record the first iter dispatched, always pass.
56	# We record across all stages because the very first dispatch call reveals
57	# which iter the orchestrator started from.
58	_SPEC7_FIRST_ITER=-1
59	cycle_dispatch_stage() {
60	    local stage="$1" iter="$2"
61	    if [[ "$_SPEC7_FIRST_ITER" -eq -1 ]]; then
62	        _SPEC7_FIRST_ITER="$iter"
63	    fi
64	    _CYCLE_DISPATCH_VERDICT="pass"
65	    _CYCLE_DISPATCH_STATUS="complete"
66	    return 0
67	}
68	
69	# The report stub makes the test member report zero test failures (pass).
70	zb_stub_reports_tests test
71	
72	# Run the cycle orchestrator against the seeded state.
73	# Before this change: loop starts at iter=1 → first dispatch is iter=1.
74	# After this change: loop reads current_iter=1 → starts at iter=2 → first is 2.
75	set +e
76	cycle_orchestrator_run "build-test" "$ZBUILD_STATE_DIR" "$STATE_FILE"
77	_s7_rc=$?
78	set -e
79	
80	# [#1805/SPEC-7]: first dispatched iter must be 2, not 1.
81	# Before the change: _SPEC7_FIRST_ITER=1 → assert 2==1 → FAILS.
82	# After the change:  _SPEC7_FIRST_ITER=2 → assert 2==2 → PASSES.
83	assert_eq \
84	    "[#1805/SPEC-7] first dispatched iter is 2 (resumed from current_iter=1, not restarted from 1)" \
85	    "2" "$_SPEC7_FIRST_ITER"
86	
87	# [#1805/SPEC-7]: no cycle.iteration.complete event for iter=1
88	# (the orchestrator never ran iter-1, so it emits no completion for it).
89	_s7_iter1_complete=0
90	if [[ -f "$ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL" ]]; then
91	    _s7_iter1_complete="$(jq -r \
92	        'select(.type=="cycle.iteration.complete") | .data.iter // empty' \
93	        "$ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^1$' 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
94	fi
95	assert_eq \
96	    "[#1805/SPEC-7] no cycle.iteration.complete for iter=1 (iter-1 was already done before resume)" \
97	    "0" "$_s7_iter1_complete"
98	
99	# ── SPEC-13: test uses a fixture containing a cyclic stage ────────────────────
100	print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-13] resume-loop-state test uses a fixture containing a cyclic stage"
101

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Tests: cycle orchestrator reads persisted current_iter and starts the
# iteration loop from that value (not 1) on resume. (issue #1805, ADR-006 §3.5)
#
# SPEC-7 [code]: Cycle orchestrator reads cycle_iterations[CYCLE_ID].current_iter
#   from persisted state at resume and starts the iteration loop from that value
#   (not 1); iter-1 complete stages emit no stage.start on resume into iter-2.
#   Its test must FAIL on the code as it was before this change.
set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
FIXT="$REPO_ROOT/tests/fixtures/templates"

# shellcheck source=../../scripts/lib/helpers.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/lib/helpers.sh"
# shellcheck source=../../scripts/lib/test-helpers.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/lib/test-helpers.sh"

print_test_header "resume-loop-state — cycle orchestrator resumes from persisted iter (#1805)"
setup_test_env "resume-loop-state-1805"

export ZBUILD_EVENT_SCHEMA="$REPO_ROOT/config/event-schema.json"
export ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/events"
export ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL="$ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR/events.jsonl"
export ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/state"
mkdir -p "$ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR" "$ZBUILD_STATE_DIR"

# shellcheck source=../../core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh"
# shellcheck source=../../core/pipeline/template.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/core/pipeline/template.sh"
# shellcheck source=../lib/cycle-report-stub.sh
source "$REPO_ROOT/tests/lib/cycle-report-stub.sh"

STATE_FILE="$ZBUILD_STATE_DIR/pipeline-state.json"

# ── SPEC-7: cycle starts from persisted current_iter on resume ─────────────────
print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-7] cycle orchestrator resumes from current_iter (not 1)"

# Seed minimal state file required by _cycle_state_init.
: > "$ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL"
jq -n '{schema_version:1, stage_statuses:{}, updated_at:"seed"}' > "$STATE_FILE"

# Use zb_engine_loop_state to write one completed iteration (current_iter=1)
# into the state file. This simulates: iter-1 of the cycle has run and
# completed; the run was then interrupted before iter-2 dispatched.
# After the change the orchestrator will read current_iter=1 and start from
# iter-2 (current_iter + 1). Before the change it starts from iter=1.
zb_engine_loop_state "$STATE_FILE" "build-test" 1 5 "in_progress"

# Load the cycle template.
load_template "$FIXT/cycle-converges-iter2.yaml"

# Mock cycle_dispatch_stage: record the first iter dispatched, always pass.
# We record across all stages because the very first dispatch call reveals
# which iter the orchestrator started from.
_SPEC7_FIRST_ITER=-1
cycle_dispatch_stage() {
    local stage="$1" iter="$2"
    if [[ "$_SPEC7_FIRST_ITER" -eq -1 ]]; then
        _SPEC7_FIRST_ITER="$iter"
    fi
    _CYCLE_DISPATCH_VERDICT="pass"
    _CYCLE_DISPATCH_STATUS="complete"
    return 0
}

# The report stub makes the test member report zero test failures (pass).
zb_stub_reports_tests test

# Run the cycle orchestrator against the seeded state.
# Before this change: loop starts at iter=1 → first dispatch is iter=1.
# After this change: loop reads current_iter=1 → starts at iter=2 → first is 2.
set +e
cycle_orchestrator_run "build-test" "$ZBUILD_STATE_DIR" "$STATE_FILE"
_s7_rc=$?
set -e

# [#1805/SPEC-7]: first dispatched iter must be 2, not 1.
# Before the change: _SPEC7_FIRST_ITER=1 → assert 2==1 → FAILS.
# After the change:  _SPEC7_FIRST_ITER=2 → assert 2==2 → PASSES.
assert_eq \
    "[#1805/SPEC-7] first dispatched iter is 2 (resumed from current_iter=1, not restarted from 1)" \
    "2" "$_SPEC7_FIRST_ITER"

# [#1805/SPEC-7]: no cycle.iteration.complete event for iter=1
# (the orchestrator never ran iter-1, so it emits no completion for it).
_s7_iter1_complete=0
if [[ -f "$ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL" ]]; then
    _s7_iter1_complete="$(jq -r \
        'select(.type=="cycle.iteration.complete") | .data.iter // empty' \
        "$ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^1$' 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
fi
assert_eq \
    "[#1805/SPEC-7] no cycle.iteration.complete for iter=1 (iter-1 was already done before resume)" \
    "0" "$_s7_iter1_complete"

# ── SPEC-13: test uses a fixture containing a cyclic stage ────────────────────
print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-13] resume-loop-state test uses a fixture containing a cyclic stage"

# cycle-converges-iter2.yaml is loaded above via load_template and driven through
# cycle_orchestrator_run. Assert it contains type: cycle to formally pin the fixture
# contains a cyclic stage (as this test's SPEC-13 contract requires).
_s13_loop_fixt_content="$(cat "$FIXT/cycle-converges-iter2.yaml")"
assert_contains "[#1805/SPEC-13] cycle fixture used by resume-loop-state test has type: cycle" \
    "$_s13_loop_fixt_content" "type: cycle"

# Also assert the pipeline was actually run: cycle_dispatch_stage was invoked
# during cycle_orchestrator_run above, setting _SPEC7_FIRST_ITER from its
# initial -1.  A value > -1 proves the cyclic stage was dispatched.
assert_gt \
    "[#1805/SPEC-13] resume-loop-state ran the cyclic pipeline (cycle_dispatch_stage was invoked)" \
    "$_SPEC7_FIRST_ITER" "-1"

cleanup_test_env
print_test_results
exit $((FAIL > 0))

301	_s13_ep_cycled_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start") | .data.stage // empty' \

PLUGINS_ROOT="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/plugins"

# ── Shared helper: set up a work repo with a state branch for one path ──────────
# Usage: _setup_path_state <label> <issue_id> → sets:
#   P_WORK_REPO, P_STATE_DIR, P_STATE_FILE, P_EVENTS_DIR, P_EVENTS_JSONL
_setup_path_state() {
    local label="$1" issue_id="$2"

    P_WORK_REPO="$(setup_git_temp_repo "ep-${label}")"
    install_template_overlay "$P_WORK_REPO" runner-state-dir-minimal

    P_STATE_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/${label}-state"
    P_EVENTS_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/${label}-events"
    P_STATE_FILE="$P_STATE_DIR/pipeline-state.json"
    P_EVENTS_JSONL="$P_EVENTS_DIR/events.jsonl"
    mkdir -p "$P_STATE_DIR/artifacts" "$P_EVENTS_DIR"

    # Write the intake artifact so the snapshot captures it.
    printf '{"result_contract":3,"outcome":"pass","reason":"prior-run intake"}' \
        > "$P_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"

    # Snapshot onto the state branch.
    local _snap_rc=0
    ( export ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$P_STATE_DIR"
      cd "$P_WORK_REPO" && _artifact_persist_snapshot "$P_STATE_DIR" "$issue_id" ) \
        >"$TEST_TEMP_DIR/${label}-snap.log" 2>&1 || _snap_rc=$?
    if [[ "$_snap_rc" -ne 0 ]]; then
        assert_fail "setup-${label}: snapshot to state branch failed" \
            "rc=$_snap_rc; $(cat "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/${label}-snap.log" 2>/dev/null | tail -5)"
    fi

    # Remove artifact from disk; it now lives only on the state branch.
    rm -f "$P_STATE_DIR/artifacts/intake-result.json"
}

print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-9] path 1: bash runner.sh --resume restores artifacts"

P1_ID="$(zb_test_issue)"
_setup_path_state "p1" "$P1_ID"

# ── PATH 2: auto-resume on detecting status=interrupted ───────────────────────
print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-9] path 2: auto-resume on status=interrupted restores artifacts"

P2_ID="$(zb_test_issue)"

# status=interrupted → get_resume_recommendation → auto_resume → resume_mode=true.

print_test_section "[#1805/SPEC-13] resume-entry-points test uses a fixture containing a cyclic stage"

_S13_EP_WORK="$(setup_git_temp_repo ep-s13-cycle-check)"

    ZBUILD_PLUGINS_ROOT="$PLUGINS_ROOT" \
    ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$_S13_EP_STATE_DIR" \

    ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL="$_S13_EP_EVENTS_JSONL" \
    ZBUILD_EVENT_SCHEMA="$REPO_ROOT/config/event-schema.json" \

    ZBUILD_VISION_GATE=off \

_s13_ep_content="$(cat "$REPO_ROOT/tests/fixtures/templates/artifact-snapshot-coverage.yaml")"

    "$_S13_EP_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^intake$' || echo 0)"
assert_eq "[#1805/SPEC-13] cyclic fixture pipeline ran in resume-entry-points test (intake dispatched)" \
    "1" "$_s13_ep_intake_starts"

# [#1805/SPEC-13]: confirm the cyclic STAGE ran (cycled dispatched), proving the
# pipeline executed the cycle body — not just a non-cyclic pipeline.
# Intake dispatching alone doesn't prove a cyclic stage ran; this does.
_s13_ep_cycled_starts="$(jq -r 'select(.type=="stage.start") | .data.stage // empty' \
    "$_S13_EP_EVENTS_JSONL" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^cycled$' || echo 0)"
assert_gt "[#1805/SPEC-13] cyclic stage 'cycled' dispatched — pipeline containing cyclic stage ran in resume-entry-points test" \
    "$_s13_ep_cycled_starts" "0"

cleanup_test_env
print_test_results
exit $((FAIL > 0))

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
# ║  zBuild helpers — color output, atomic writes, JSON validation            ║
# ╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
#
# Phase 0 minimal primitives. Full safety chokepoints (validate_json hot-path
# wiring, check_disk_space on every artifact write, etc.) land as part of the
# core/ engine when individual keepers migrate from legacy-DoNotUse/.

[[ -n "${_ZBUILD_HELPERS_LOADED:-}" ]] && return 0
_ZBUILD_HELPERS_LOADED=1
# The process's umask, read once when it loads this file, for atomic_write to
# put back: nothing in the engine changes it, and every subshell then inherits
# it instead of starting one more to read it (ADR-065 §5, round 9).
_ZB_UMASK="$(umask)"

# Source compat first (Bash 5 check, platform detection)
_ZBUILD_SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "${BASH_SOURCE[0]%/*}" 2>/dev/null || true; pwd)"
# shellcheck source=./compat.sh
source "$_ZBUILD_SCRIPT_DIR/compat.sh"

# ─── Colors (NO_COLOR-aware, FORCE_COLOR override) ───────────────────────────
# FORCE_COLOR=1 wins over the tty check so tests/CI can pin colored output
# without a real terminal. NO_COLOR still wins over FORCE_COLOR (POSIX-ish
# convention: explicit opt-out beats explicit opt-in).
if [[ -n "${NO_COLOR:-}" || ( "${FORCE_COLOR:-0}" != "1" && ! -t 1 ) ]]; then
    CYAN=''; PURPLE=''; BLUE=''; LIGHT_BLUE=''; GREEN=''; YELLOW=''; RED=''; DIM=''; BOLD=''; RESET=''
else
    CYAN='\033[38;2;0;212;255m'
    PURPLE='\033[38;2;124;58;237m'
    BLUE='\033[38;2;0;102;255m'
    LIGHT_BLUE='\033[38;2;100;200;255m'
    GREEN='\033[38;2;74;222;128m'
    YELLOW='\033[38;2;250;204;21m'
    RED='\033[38;2;248;113;113m'
    DIM='\033[2m'
    BOLD='\033[1m'
    RESET='\033[0m'
fi
export CYAN PURPLE BLUE LIGHT_BLUE GREEN YELLOW RED DIM BOLD RESET

info()    { echo -e "${CYAN}${BOLD}▸${RESET} $*"; }
success() { echo -e "${GREEN}${BOLD}✓${RESET} $*"; }
warn()    { echo -e "${YELLOW}${BOLD}⚠${RESET} $*" >&2; }
error()   { echo -e "${RED}${BOLD}✗${RESET} $*" >&2; }

# ─── atomic_replace <src> <dst> ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# Copy src to a unique temp in dst's directory, then rename it into place. A
# concurrent reader of dst never observes a torn intermediate (mv is an atomic
# rename on a POSIX filesystem; the temp shares dst's dir → same filesystem).
# Returns 1 (cleaning up the temp) on copy failure. Does NOT validate JSON or
# check disk space — callers own that. The copy keeps src's mode (`cp -p`), so a
# state file's .bak stays 0600 as the state is. (#909 / ADR-006)
atomic_replace() {
    local src="$1" dst="$2"
    local tmp="" _n _nc=0
    # Every failure path returns non-zero (never aborts a `set -e` caller) and
    # leaves no stray temp. The temp's name is made by the shell and claimed with
    # noclobber, so it is exclusive the way mktemp's was (ADR-065 §5).
    [[ $- == *C* ]] && _nc=1
    for _n in 1 2 3; do
        tmp="${dst}.tmp.${BASHPID}.${RANDOM}${RANDOM}"
        { set -C; : > "$tmp"; } 2>/dev/null && break
        tmp=""
    done
    (( _nc )) || set +C
    [[ -n "$tmp" ]] || return 1
    if ! cp -p -- "$src" "$tmp" 2>/dev/null; then
        rm -f "$tmp"
        return 1
    fi
    if ! mv -- "$tmp" "$dst" 2>/dev/null; then
        rm -f "$tmp"
        return 1
    fi
}

3	# ║  zBuild test-helpers — Shared test harness for all unit tests        ║
4	# ║  Source this from any *-test.sh file to get assert_*, setup, teardown    ║
5	# ╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝

7	# Usage:
8	#   SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "${BASH_SOURCE[0]%/*}" 2>/dev/null || true; pwd)"
9	#   source "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/test-helpers.sh"

20	# ─── Re-entrancy guard (#971): refuse a test invoked inside another test run ──
21	# Every *-test.sh sources this file first, so this is the universal chokepoint.
22	# A test executed from WITHIN another test run — e.g. the ablation negctl/
23	# reachability gates run `bash <changed-test>` directly — would re-enter the gate
24	# logic and fork-bomb the pipeline test stage (the recurring #929/#983/#971 class).
25	# The #983 guard in run-tests.sh only catches run-tests.sh-mediated nesting; the
26	# ablation's direct `bash` bypasses it. This guard catches BOTH paths.
27	# The sentinel has NO leading underscore so env-scrub's ^(ZBUILD_|_TPL_) clears it
28	# at every fresh-user-shell boundary (the pipeline test stage), avoiding a stale-
29	# value false refusal. Fixture-isolated nested runs set ZBUILD_TESTS_DIR and are
30	# exempt (mirrors the #983 guard's exemption). The guard fires ONLY when $0 is a
31	# `*-test.sh` being EXECUTED (`bash <test>.sh` — the ablation/fork-bomb path), not
32	# when a script merely sources this file for introspection (`bash -c "source …"`,
33	# where $0 is `bash`) — so test-helpers' own self-tests are unaffected.
34	if [[ -n "${ZBUILD_TEST_EXEC_ACTIVE:-}" && -z "${ZBUILD_TESTS_DIR:-}" && "${0##*/}" == *-test.sh ]]; then
35	    echo "test-helpers.sh: refusing nested test invocation (re-entrancy guard #971)" >&2

67	# ─── Auto-initialize TEST_TEMP_DIR ──────────────────────────────────────────
68	# Many test files use TEST_TEMP_DIR in their setup_env() without calling
69	# setup_test_env(). Auto-create a temp dir so $TEST_TEMP_DIR is never empty.
70	# Save originals now so cleanup_test_env() can always restore them.
71	ORIG_HOME="${HOME}"
72	ORIG_PATH="${PATH}"
73	# Sandbox ZBUILD_STATE_DIR and ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR so stage-io writes during
74	# tests never escape to the outer pipeline's state directory (#1713).
75	# `+set` records SET-ness separately from the value: `${VAR:-}` collapses "unset"
76	# and "set but empty" into the same "", and cleanup would then unset a variable
77	# the caller had deliberately exported as empty. `${VAR-}` (no colon) keeps an
78	# empty value as empty.

95	# Sandbox mktemp shim — macOS plain `mktemp`/`mktemp -d` (no template) ignores
96	# $TMPDIR and uses /var/folders which is write-blocked in the sandbox.
97	# Route templateless calls through a writable directory.

99	# one would break test setup_env() loops that do `ln -sf "$(command -v mktemp)"`
100	# because command -v resolves to the shim itself (same-file ln error).

102	    printf '#!/usr/bin/env bash\n_s="%s"\nif [[ $# -eq 0 ]]; then exec /usr/bin/mktemp "$_s/tmp.XXXXXX"; fi\nif [[ $# -eq 1 && "$1" == "-d" ]]; then exec /usr/bin/mktemp -d "$_s/tmpd.XXXXXX"; fi\nexec /usr/bin/mktemp "$@"\n' \
103	        "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/_tmp" > "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/bin/mktemp"

107	# ─── Child-process killer (used by master trap) ──────────────────────────────
108	_kill_test_children() {
109	    local pids
110	    pids=$(jobs -p 2>/dev/null) || true
111	    # shellcheck disable=SC2086  # word splitting intentional to pass multiple PIDs
112	    [[ -n "$pids" ]] && kill $pids 2>/dev/null || true
113	    pkill -P $$ 2>/dev/null || true
114	    wait 2>/dev/null || true

117	# ─── Script-level cleanup hook — override in each test script ────────────────
118	# Default is a no-op; scripts set: _test_cleanup_hook() { cleanup_env; }
119	_test_cleanup_hook() { :; }

121	# ─── Master trap — kills children, calls hook, removes auto temp dir ─────────
122	# _HARNESS_SIGNAL: set by dedicated INT/TERM wrappers before calling cleanup,
123	# so _test_harness_cleanup can re-raise and exit 128+signal instead of
124	# returning into the interrupted test body (which would produce bogus failures).
125	# _HARNESS_CLEANED_UP: idempotency guard — prevents double cleanup when both
126	# a signal handler and the EXIT trap would otherwise call the body.
127	_HARNESS_SIGNAL=""
128	_HARNESS_CLEANED_UP=0
129	
130	_test_harness_cleanup() {
131	    [[ "${_HARNESS_CLEANED_UP:-0}" == "1" ]] && return 0
132	    _HARNESS_CLEANED_UP=1
133	    _kill_test_children
134	    _test_cleanup_hook
135	    if [[ -n "${AUTO_TEST_TEMP_DIR:-}" && -d "$AUTO_TEST_TEMP_DIR" ]]; then
136	        rm -rf "$AUTO_TEST_TEMP_DIR"
137	    fi
138	    # Wave 19-L (#749): rm each named TEST_TEMP_DIR setup_test_env created
139	    # so tests that forgot _test_cleanup_hook / cleanup_test_env stop
140	    # leaking. Path-prefix guard against accidental rm-rf-/: each tracked
141	    # path must live under the source-time tmp-root captured in
142	    # _ZB_TEST_TMP_ROOT. Using the CURRENT $TMPDIR would fail when tests
143	    # re-export TMPDIR (Copilot review #751); the source-time root is
144	    # stable for the process lifetime since AUTO_TEST_TEMP_DIR was created
145	    # there. (mktemp -d always returns an absolute path so the prefix
146	    # check is meaningful.)
147	    local _trk
148	    for _trk in "${_TRACKED_TEST_TEMP_DIRS[@]:-}"; do
149	        [[ -z "$_trk" ]] && continue
150	        [[ "$_trk" == "$_ZB_TEST_TMP_ROOT"/* ]] || continue
151	        [[ -d "$_trk" ]] && rm -rf "$_trk" 2>/dev/null || true
152	    done
153	    # Signal-triggered teardown: clear both the signal trap and EXIT so the
154	    # re-raised signal exits with 128+N (143/130) without running EXIT again.
155	    if [[ -n "${_HARNESS_SIGNAL:-}" ]]; then
156	        trap - "${_HARNESS_SIGNAL}" EXIT
157	        kill -"${_HARNESS_SIGNAL}" $$
158	    fi
159	}

161	# Thin wrappers installed for TERM and INT: record the in-flight signal name
162	# then call the shared cleanup body. The cleanup body re-raises at the tail
163	# so the process exits 128+signal instead of returning into the test body.
164	_harness_signal_handler() {
165	    local _sig="$1"
166	    _HARNESS_SIGNAL="$_sig"

179	assert_pass() {
180	    local desc="$1"
181	    TOTAL=$((TOTAL + 1))
182	    PASS=$((PASS + 1))
183	    # #600: ZBUILD_TEST_QUIET=1 suppresses per-assertion echoes to keep the
184	    # pipeline test-stage banner compact. Counters still update; assert_fail
185	    # is intentionally NOT gated (failures always surface).
186	    [[ "${ZBUILD_TEST_QUIET:-0}" == "1" ]] && return 0
187	    echo -e "  ${GREEN}✓${RESET} ${desc}"

190	assert_fail() {
191	    local desc="$1"
192	    local detail="${2:-}"
193	    TOTAL=$((TOTAL + 1))
194	    FAIL=$((FAIL + 1))
195	    FAILURES[${#FAILURES[@]}]="$desc"
196	    echo -e "  ${RED}✗${RESET} ${desc}"
197	    # An `if`, not `[[ … ]] && …` as the last line: with no detail that returned
198	    # 1, and under `set -e` the file stopped at its first failure — every later
199	    # assertion went unmeasured (#2234; 13 SPECs on #1835).
200	    if [[ -n "$detail" ]]; then echo -e "    ${DIM}${detail}${RESET}"; fi

220	        assert_pass "$desc"

295	# ─── Which engine locations a test may share (#2252 F, #1910) ────────────────
296	# Every ZBUILD_* variable naming a place the engine WRITES is cleared per test,
297	# so it falls back to the sandboxed $HOME (below) or whatever the test sets
298	# after setup. The pipeline's test stage exports ZBUILD_STATE_ROOT, a cost
299	# ledger and a cache dir for the suite it runs; clearing only STATE_DIR and
300	# ARTIFACT_DIR let every test file share one stage-io folder and seq counter
301	# (#2032 run 36969130031). tests/unit/test-env-isolation-test.sh fails on any
302	# location variable the engine reads that is in neither list.
303	_ZB_TEST_ISOLATED_VARS=(
304	    ZBUILD_STATE_ROOT ZBUILD_STATE_DIR ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR ZBUILD_STATE_FILE
305	    ZBUILD_DATA_ROOT ZBUILD_RUN_ROOT ZBUILD_POOL_ROOT ZBUILD_SCRATCH_ROOT
306	    ZBUILD_WORKTREE_ROOT ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS ZBUILD_STAGE_BLOCKS

310	    ZBUILD_WIKI_ROOT ZBUILD_INSTALL_DIR ZBUILD_BIN_DIR
311	)

313	# by run-tests.sh across files (the timing file).
314	_ZB_TEST_INHERITED_VARS=(
315	    ZBUILD_PLUGINS_ROOT ZBUILD_PLUGINS_DIR ZBUILD_PLUGIN_DIR ZBUILD_CORE_DIR
316	    ZBUILD_CONTRACT_LIB_DIR ZBUILD_REPO_ROOT ZBUILD_MAIN_REPO_ROOT ZBUILD_PROJECT_ROOT

322	# _zb_test_stage_blocks <dir> — the engine's three blocks for a stage that has
323	# no repository settings, no earlier stage and no manifest, written with the
324	# engine's own writers (#1799: never hand-made).
325	_zb_test_stage_blocks() {
326	    local dir="$1"

328	        # shellcheck source=./stage-prompt.sh
329	        source "$(cd "${BASH_SOURCE[0]%/*}" 2>/dev/null || true; pwd)/stage-prompt.sh" || exit 1
330	        mkdir -p "$dir" "$dir/repo" "$dir/state" || exit 1

341	zb_test_previous_work() {

345	        # shellcheck source=./stage-prompt.sh

348	            || source "$(cd "${BASH_SOURCE[0]%/*}" 2>/dev/null || true; cd "../.." && pwd)/core/pipeline/input-resolve.sh" || exit 1
349	        _stage_block_previous_work "$consumer" "$sd" "$proot" \

354	setup_test_env() {
355	    local test_name="${1:-zb-test}"
356	    # Clean up auto-created temp dir and create a named one
357	    [[ -n "$TEST_TEMP_DIR" && -d "$TEST_TEMP_DIR" ]] && rm -rf "$TEST_TEMP_DIR"
358	    TEST_TEMP_DIR=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/${test_name}.XXXXXX")
359	    # Wave 19-L (#749): register the named TEST_TEMP_DIR for cleanup in the
360	    # master trap. Without this, tests that forget to set _test_cleanup_hook
361	    # or call cleanup_test_env leak the named dir. Audit (2026-06-08) found
362	    # 44 of 245 setup_test_env callsites had this gap → 1,261 leaked dirs.
363	    # The master trap (_test_harness_cleanup) reads _TRACKED_TEST_TEMP_DIRS
364	    # and rm -rf's each, in addition to AUTO_TEST_TEMP_DIR.
365	    _TRACKED_TEST_TEMP_DIRS+=("$TEST_TEMP_DIR")
366	    mkdir -p "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/home/.zbuild"
367	    mkdir -p "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/bin"
368	    mkdir -p "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/project"
369	    mkdir -p "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/logs"
370	
371	    # ORIG_HOME/ORIG_PATH/ORIG_STATE_DIR already saved at source time.
372	    export HOME="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/home"
373	    export PATH="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/bin:$PATH"
374	    # Unset ZBUILD_STATE_DIR and ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR so any ambient pipeline
375	    # values do not leak into this test process (#1713). stage-io falls back to
376	    # ${HOME}/.zbuild/state (sandboxed above) when both are unset, landing all
377	    # writes in the sandbox. We unset rather than redirect to avoid perturbing
378	    # callers that manage their own artifact paths after setup.
379	    mkdir -p "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/home/.zbuild/state"
380	    # #2252 F: every written location, not only STATE_DIR / ARTIFACT_DIR.
381	    unset "${_ZB_TEST_ISOLATED_VARS[@]}"
382	    # The event bus resolves its paths when it is SOURCED — usually before this
383	    # call, with the real $HOME — so clearing them would leave it nowhere to
384	    # write, and leaving them would write under the real ~/.zbuild. Point them
385	    # into this test's own folder; a test that wants its own sets them after.
386	    export ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/events"
387	    export ZBUILD_EVENTS_JSONL="$ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR/events.jsonl"
388	    mkdir -p "$ZBUILD_EVENTS_DIR"
389	    export NO_GITHUB=true
390	    export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
391	
392	    # ADR-067 §8: a stage that calls a model composes its prompt with the
393	    # engine's three blocks, which plugin_hook_call writes at dispatch. A test
394	    # that calls a stage's run function directly gets a minimal set, written by
395	    # the engine's own code; a test about the blocks sets its own.
396	    _zb_test_stage_blocks "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/stage-blocks" \
397	        && export ZBUILD_STAGE_BLOCKS="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/stage-blocks"
398	
399	    # Prevent CI-environment leakage into the test subprocess.
400	    # GitHub Actions exports WORKSPACE_BRANCH and (in some workflows) CI_MODE; if
401	    # those leak into stage-level unit tests they silently divert intake into the
402	    # CI-workspace-branch path, breaking branch-creation assertions.
403	    unset WORKSPACE_BRANCH CI_MODE
404	
405	    # Link real jq if available
406	    if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
407	        ln -sf "$(command -v jq)" "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/bin/jq"
408	    fi
409	
410	    # Mock timeout — macOS doesn't have GNU coreutils timeout by default
411	    if ! command -v timeout >/dev/null 2>&1; then
412	        cat > "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/bin/timeout" <<'TIMEOUT_EOF'
413	#!/usr/bin/env bash
414	shift  # skip the timeout duration
415	exec "$@"
416	TIMEOUT_EOF
417	        chmod +x "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/bin/timeout"
418	    fi
419	
420	    # Sandbox mktemp shim — macOS only (see auto-init comment above for rationale).
421	    mkdir -p "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/_tmp"
422	    if [[ "$(uname -s 2>/dev/null)" == "Darwin" ]]; then
423	        printf '#!/usr/bin/env bash\n_s="%s"\nif [[ $# -eq 0 ]]; then exec /usr/bin/mktemp "$_s/tmp.XXXXXX"; fi\nif [[ $# -eq 1 && "$1" == "-d" ]]; then exec /usr/bin/mktemp -d "$_s/tmpd.XXXXXX"; fi\nexec /usr/bin/mktemp "$@"\n' \
424	            "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/_tmp" > "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/bin/mktemp"
425	        chmod +x "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/bin/mktemp"
426	    fi
427	}

436	# 9_0000000+ is unreachable: this repo is ~2000 issues in. A stray
437	# zbuild/state/issue-9xxxxxxx ref is therefore unmistakably test residue, safe to
438	# reclaim, and can never be confused with someone's work.
439	# The floor of the reserved range. Read by lint-test-identity and the hygiene
440	# test; zb_test_issue composes its ids to always land at or above it.
441	ZB_TEST_ISSUE_FLOOR=90000000
442	export ZB_TEST_ISSUE_FLOOR
443	
444	# Sequential within a test file: 90000001, 90000002, … Files repeat the same ids,
445	# which is safe because each runs in its own throwaway repo — and if one ever
446	# escapes, the number identifies it instantly.
447	# The counter lives in a FILE, not a shell variable: callers use $(zb_test_issue),
448	# which runs in a subshell, so an in-memory counter would never advance and every
449	# call would return the same id.
450	#
451	# The id is keyed on the PID so two test files running in PARALLEL never mint the
452	# same one. They otherwise all start at 90000001, and the teardown below deletes
453	# refs from the SHARED checkout — so one file's cleanup could delete a ref another
454	# file was still asserting on. The unit tier is parallel by default (#984), and
455	# more cores make that likelier, which is why it showed on Linux CI first.
456	#
457	# Shape: 9 + PID%1000 (3) + seq (4) — always 8 digits, always >= 90000000.
458	zb_test_issue() {
459	    local dir="${TEST_TEMP_DIR:-${TMPDIR:-/tmp}}"
460	    local f="$dir/.zb-test-issue-seq"
461	    local n=0
462	    [[ -r "$f" ]] && n="$(cat "$f" 2>/dev/null || printf '0')"
463	    [[ "$n" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || n=0
464	    n=$(( n + 1 ))
465	    printf '%d' "$n" > "$f" 2>/dev/null || true
466	    local id
467	    id="$(printf '9%03d%04d' "$(( $$ % 1000 ))" "$n")"
468	    # Record it, so teardown removes exactly the refs THIS file minted rather
469	    # than every reserved ref it happens to find.
470	    printf '%s\n' "$id" >> "$dir/.zb-test-issue-minted" 2>/dev/null || true
471	    printf '%s' "$id"
472	}
473	
474	# Goal fixtures get the same treatment: the marker makes zbuild/state/goal-<hash>
475	# traceable back to a test even though the hash itself is opaque.
476	#
477	# The hash is RECORDED as it is handed out, exactly as zb_test_issue records ids.
478	# Without that, goal refs had no teardown and no guard — which is precisely how
479	# the leak fixed in this branch survived a full identity sweep unnoticed. The
480	# derivation mirrors zbuild_goal_key: sha256 of the text with all whitespace
481	# stripped, truncated to 12 hex.
482	zb_test_goal() {
483	    local text; text="$(printf '[zb-test] %s' "${1:-fixture}")"
484	    local dir="${TEST_TEMP_DIR:-${TMPDIR:-/tmp}}"
485	    local h
486	    h="$(printf '%s' "$text" | tr -d '[:space:]' | shasum -a 256 | cut -c1-12)"
487	    printf '%s\n' "$h" >> "$dir/.zb-test-goal-minted" 2>/dev/null || true
488	    printf '%s' "$text"
489	}

491	# A throwaway repo WITH an origin. setup_git_temp_repo builds the working tree;
492	# this adds the bare remote a push needs. Promoted out of persist-stage-test.sh,
493	# where it lived as _mk_repo.
494	zb_test_repo() {
495	    local name="${1:-zbrepo}"
496	    local remote="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/$name-remote.git"
497	    local repo
498	    repo="$(setup_git_temp_repo "$name")" || return 1
499	    local real_git; real_git="$(command -v git 2>/dev/null || echo /usr/bin/git)"
500	    (
501	        "$real_git" init -q --bare "$remote"
502	        cd "$repo" || exit 1
503	        "$real_git" remote add origin "$remote"
504	        "$real_git" push -q -u origin main
505	    ) >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1
506	    printf '%s\n' "$repo"
507	}

509	# Reserved-range state refs in a repo (default: the real checkout). Used by both
510	# the teardown below and the suite-wide hygiene guard.
511	# shellcheck disable=SC2120  # callers live in tests/, which CI's shellcheck step
512	# does not scan (it covers scripts core plugins), so the optional repo argument
513	# looks unpassed from inside this file alone.
514	zb_test_reserved_refs() {
515	    local repo="${1:-${REPO_ROOT:-$PWD}}"
516	    # Prefix glob, then a NUMERIC filter — not 'issue-9???????'. That counted
517	    # characters, so it covered 90000000-99999999 only, while lint-test-identity
518	    # and _cleanup_issue_ref_decision both gate on >= 90000000. An id above the
519	    # 8-digit range would have passed both and been invisible here.
520	    local _ref _n
521	    while IFS= read -r _ref; do
522	        [[ -n "$_ref" ]] || continue
523	        _n="${_ref##*/issue-}"
524	        [[ "$_n" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || continue
525	        # An explicit if, not `[[ … ]] && printf`: the && form returns non-zero
526	        # when the test is false, and as the last command in the loop body that
527	        # aborts callers running under `set -e`.
528	        if [[ "$_n" -ge "${ZB_TEST_ISSUE_FLOOR:-90000000}" ]]; then
529	            printf '%s\n' "$_ref"
530	        fi
531	    done < <(git -C "$repo" for-each-ref --format='%(refname)' \
532	        'refs/heads/zbuild/state/issue-9*' 2>/dev/null || true)
533	}

535	cleanup_test_env() {
536	    # Remove state refs THIS FILE minted and may have written into the real
537	    # checkout. Deliberately not "every reserved ref present": the unit tier runs
538	    # in parallel, so deleting another file's in-flight ref would fail its
539	    # assertions. Reserved-range by construction, so a real issue's branch is
540	    # never touched — not even one already contaminated.
541	    local _minted="${TEST_TEMP_DIR:-}/.zb-test-issue-minted"
542	    if [[ -n "${TEST_TEMP_DIR:-}" && -r "$_minted" ]]; then
543	        local _id
544	        while IFS= read -r _id; do
545	            [[ "$_id" =~ ^9[0-9]{7}$ ]] || continue
546	            git -C "${REPO_ROOT:-$PWD}" update-ref -d \
547	                "refs/heads/zbuild/state/issue-$_id" 2>/dev/null || true
548	        done < "$_minted"
549	    fi
550	    local _gminted="${TEST_TEMP_DIR:-}/.zb-test-goal-minted"
551	    if [[ -n "${TEST_TEMP_DIR:-}" && -r "$_gminted" ]]; then
552	        local _h
553	        while IFS= read -r _h; do
554	            [[ "$_h" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{12}$ ]] || continue
555	            git -C "${REPO_ROOT:-$PWD}" update-ref -d \
556	                "refs/heads/zbuild/state/goal-$_h" 2>/dev/null || true
557	        done < "$_gminted"
558	    fi
559	
560	    if [[ -n "$TEST_TEMP_DIR" && -d "$TEST_TEMP_DIR" ]]; then
561	        rm -rf "$TEST_TEMP_DIR" 2>/dev/null || true
562	    fi
563	    [[ -n "${ORIG_HOME:-}" ]] && export HOME="$ORIG_HOME" || true
564	    [[ -n "${ORIG_PATH:-}" ]] && export PATH="$ORIG_PATH" || true
565	    # Restore ZBUILD_STATE_DIR and ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR to pre-setup values
566	    # (or unset them if they were not set before this test sourced the helpers).
567	    if [[ -n "${ORIG_STATE_DIR_SET:-}" ]]; then
568	        export ZBUILD_STATE_DIR="$ORIG_STATE_DIR"
569	    else
570	        unset ZBUILD_STATE_DIR
571	    fi
572	    if [[ -n "${ORIG_ARTIFACT_DIR_SET:-}" ]]; then
573	        export ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR="$ORIG_ARTIFACT_DIR"
574	    else
575	        unset ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR
576	    fi
577	}

621	# Install an envelope-aware mock claude binary on PATH ($TEST_TEMP_DIR/bin).
622	# Branches on argv: when invoked with `--output-format json` (ADR-018 Pattern 1
623	# decision #8, #476), wraps the payload in a {type:result,result:...} envelope
624	# so the router's `.result` extraction finds it. Otherwise emits the payload
625	# as raw text (legacy text-mode callers).
626	#
627	# Usage:
628	#   install_envelope_mock_claude <payload>                        # payload is inline text
629	#   install_envelope_mock_claude --file <payload_file>            # payload comes from a file at call time
630	#   install_envelope_mock_claude --record-argv <path> <payload>   # also record argv to <path>
631	#   install_envelope_mock_claude --record-prompt <path> <payload> # also record `-p <prompt>` to <path>
632	#
633	# Flags may be combined (e.g. --file + --record-argv).
634	install_envelope_mock_claude() {
635	    local payload="" payload_file="" argv_record="" prompt_record=""
636	    while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
637	        case "$1" in
638	            --file)          payload_file="$2"; shift 2 ;;
639	            --record-argv)   argv_record="$2"; shift 2 ;;
640	            --record-prompt) prompt_record="$2"; shift 2 ;;
641	            *)               payload="$1"; shift ;;
642	        esac
643	    done
644	    mkdir -p "$TEST_TEMP_DIR/bin"
645	    local mock_bin="$TEST_TEMP_DIR/bin/claude"
646	    cat > "$mock_bin" <<MOCK
647	#!/usr/bin/env bash
648	# Auto-generated by install_envelope_mock_claude (#476).
649	if [[ -n "${argv_record:-}" ]]; then
650	    printf '%s\n' "\$@" > "$argv_record"
651	fi
652	envelope_mode=0
653	prompt_text=""
654	while [[ \$# -gt 0 ]]; do
655	    case "\$1" in
656	        --output-format|json) envelope_mode=1; shift ;;
657	        -p) prompt_text="\${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
658	        *)  shift ;;
659	    esac
660	done
661	# The router sends the prompt on stdin (#1849: argv overflowed at 128 KiB).
662	[[ -n "\$prompt_text" ]] || prompt_text="\$(cat)"
663	if [[ -n "${prompt_record:-}" ]]; then
664	    printf '%s' "\$prompt_text" > "$prompt_record"
665	fi
666	if [[ -n "${payload_file:-}" ]]; then
667	    payload="\$(cat "$payload_file")"
668	else
669	    payload=$(printf '%q' "$payload")
670	fi
671	if [[ \$envelope_mode -eq 1 ]]; then
672	    jq -n --arg r "\$payload" '{type:"result",subtype:"success",result:\$r,usage:{input_tokens:0,output_tokens:0},tool_uses:[]}'
673	else
674	    printf '%s\n' "\$payload"
675	fi
676	exit 0
677	MOCK
678	    chmod +x "$mock_bin"
679	}
